title: How the casino is laid out
question: Three ways to arrange the walkable casino on a phone. The look stays the iCisco galaxy; this choice is composition. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Cutaway floor
options.thesis: The whole casino is one roofless room seen from above; Axie walks it, and sitting down dollies the camera into the table.
options.viewport: High three-quarter view of the open room: slot row on the left wall, Hold'em table centre-right, cashier cage by the door; joystick bottom-left, balance chip top-right.
options.risk: From high up, the props read small on a phone until you sit down.

raised.raise: One ply only: the game deck is the single layer that ever sits above the floor.
Bots telegraph their move a beat before it lands, so the table never surprises you.

options.label: Eye-level stroll
options.thesis: You walk the floor at eye level and the games play on the objects themselves: reels spin in the cabinet glass, cards land on the felt.
options.viewport: Eye-level view down the aisle toward the slot row, marquees glowing; drag to look, joystick to move, a thin chip rail along the bottom.
options.risk: First-person on a phone needs two thumbs and can feel disorienting to non-gamers.

options.label: Floor above, rail below
options.thesis: The live 3D floor fills the top of the screen and a rail below always holds your balance, mode and the nearest game; seated, the rail becomes the controls.
options.viewport: Top 55%: diorama of the room with Axie by the slots. Bottom 45%: rail with mode switch, balance, 'Slot machine, 2 steps away' and a Sit down button.
options.risk: Half the screen is UI, so the casino feels smaller than the other two.

options.label: Acetate manual
options.thesis: Content on hinged acetate leaves over coloured divider boards.
options.viewport: An open manual at a tabbed section.
options.risk: Turns a casino into a document.
options.case: Fuses poorly: members came to walk a casino, not read a manual.
options.kept: One ply only: overlays never stack.

options.label: Vertical feed
options.thesis: One game fills the screen; the next is one flick away.
options.viewport: Slot machine full screen, poker one swipe down.
options.risk: Drops walking, which the brief asks for.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it removes the walkable floor the brief requires.
options.kept: Seated, the station owns the whole screen.

options.label: Provenance ribbon
options.thesis: One object's custody told as a ribbon.
options.viewport: A ribbon unrolling down the page.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience fit for a game room.
options.kept: Every real-deal win or loss leaves a ledger line you can see.

options.label: Gravity rain garden
options.thesis: Rain falls toward whatever its cloud's colour pulls it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neither members nor the games recognise it.
options.kept: Chips and coins fall with honest weight.

options.label: Algorave floor
options.thesis: Projected code edits the music mid-dance.
options.viewport: A code buffer as the stage.
options.case: Fuses poorly: code is not what members came to play.
options.kept: The next change is visible a beat before it lands.

options.label: Event display
options.thesis: Tracks curling out of one frozen collision.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to cards or reels.
options.kept: Inertial 3D: the camera keeps a little momentum.
